title: S111 7.6 Information Disclosure in Trace Fields
parent_path: S111 7.6 Information Disclosure in Trace Fields

statements.subject: server
statements.description: This ordinarily does not pose a problem, but sites with special concerns about name disclosure should be aware of it.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Also, the optional FOR clause should be supplied with caution or not at all when multiple recipients are involved lest it inadvertently disclose the identities of "blind copy" recipients to others.
actions: supply FOR clause with caution or omit FOR clause entirely from Received header
